notes: ledger.did is a byte-for-byte copy of packages/resolver/test/fixtures/ledger.did (W1), which is the exact file the eval harness pins and hash-checks. Untrusted third-party data: tests only pass it to the Candid parser.

sns-dapp.did and sns-dapp.profile.json are written for this package: a hypothetical SNS-governed dapp for the SNS validator rendering tests, not the interface of any real canister. Not third-party data.

wide.did and wide.profile.json are written for this package: a hypothetical interface with every Candid type a resolved form carries and every value tag, for the differential corpus of the Rust port (test/differential/). Not third-party data.
